name: Through Another World
summary:
Early Access. Through Another World is a treadmill walking experience built for simple, comfortable control. Set your speed, switch trails, and adjust your setup smoothly and simply. Press B at any time to see the controls. 

This app is a personal project as I enjoy walking in VR during the months when it's too hot, cold, or impractical to be outside.
Your feedback is greatly appreciated. What you like, what feels off, and what you’d like to see next. See developer website.
